title: Canonical ambient derived scalar restriction comparison maps
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings in $\mathrm{Type}(u+1)$, $\varphi:A\to B$ a unital ring homomorphism, and $f:Z\to W$ a morphism of schemes in universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme]. Use their small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and constant-coefficient derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $U_V:D(V_{\mathrm{et}},B)\to D(V_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ for the exact termwise descent of restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Write $L f_A^{-1}\dashv Rf_{*,A}$ and $L f_B^{-1}\dashv Rf_{*,B}$ for the derived inverse/direct-image adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Define $\rho_f:Lf_A^{-1}U_W\xrightarrow{\sim}U_ZLf_B^{-1}$ by exact derived descent of the canonical sheaf inverse-image/restriction isomorphism: that sheaf isomorphism is the uniqueness-of-left-adjoints isomorphism for the common direct-image/coextension-of-scalars right adjoint; transport its descent through the canonical identifications of exact inverse image with its left derived functor. Define $d_f:U_WRf_{*,B}\to Rf_{*,A}U_Z$ as the right-adjunction mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] of $\rho_f$. These are the specified ambient natural isomorphism and natural transformation; invertibility of $d_f$ on bounded-below inputs is a separate theorem, not part of this definition.

def scalarRestrictionDirectImageMap
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ W) :
    R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f) ⋙
        Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars W.smallEtaleTopology φ ⟶
      Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars Z.smallEtaleTopology φ ⋙
        R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f)
